facts.material: polyester knit pile (faux fur) fabric bonded to leather; leather share assumed 25% or more by weight
facts.form: women's jacket made up from a bonded laminate

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 6102 (women's overcoats, jackets and similar articles, knitted) fits a garment made from knit man-made fiber fabric; ch. 43 note 5 excludes knitted imitation furskins from 'artificial fur' (so not 4304)
GRI 3(b)/essential character: textile knit pile fabric is the face/visible material; leather laminated as backing, not a leather garment of 4203 (assumed)
GRI 6: 6102.30 man-made fibers; 6102.30.05 containing 25 percent or more by weight of leather

rejected_alternatives.reason: ch. 43 note 5: imitation fur obtained by knitting is not artificial fur
leather apparel; textile knit pile fabric gives the garment its character
residual line; the leather-bearing line 6102.30.05 is more specific

missing_facts: leather share by weight of the garment
whether leather or the faux fur face gives essential character
classification.rationale: A jacket of knitted polyester pile fabric bonded to leather is a knitted garment of heading 6102; the tariff has a specific line for man-made fiber garments containing 25 percent or more leather, which fits a garment whose fabric is bonded to leather. No directly matching ruling was cited.
